enriched_activities.desc: Lying in bed. Eyes closed. Breathing steadily. Turning from side to side. Adjusting pillow. Pulling blanket up. Remaining still. Sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and getting dressed for work
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Get out of bed. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Turn on tap. Wash hands with soap. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Take off sleepwear. Put on work clothes. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs and milk. Close refrigerator. Take out pan. Place on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs. Cook eggs. Turn off stove. Put eggs on plate. Make toast. Pour milk. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Finish. Clear dishes. Wash dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up bag. Walk to door. Open door. Close door. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Stand and wait. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look at phone. Arrive at hospital stop. Stand up. Walk to exit. Get off bus. Walk to hospital entrance. Enter hospital.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, providing patient care and completing clinical duties
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Walk to nurses' station. Receive handover. Pick up patient list. Walk to patient room. Check vital signs. Administer medication. Talk to patient. Document notes. Walk to supply room. Restock supplies. Walk to break room. Eat lunch. Return to nurses' station. Answer phone. Assist with procedure. Update records. Talk to family. End shift.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look at phone. Arrive at stop. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk to house. Open door. Enter house. Lock door.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and changing out of work clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Take off work clothes. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Wash hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Put on clean clothes. Turn off light.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Chop vegetables. Chop meat. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Add oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Cook. Turn off stove. Put food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Clear dishes. Wash dishes.

Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Press power button. Change channel. Adjust volume. Put down remote. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Get up. Walk to kitchen. Get drink. Return. Sit down. Continue watching. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer for personal tasks and reading health care updates
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to computer. Sit down. Turn on computer. Log in. Open browser. Check email. Reply to email. Browse social media. Read news. Open health care update. Read article. Take notes. Close browser. Shut down computer. Stand up.

Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Turn on tap. Wash hands. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Floss teeth. Wash face. Apply moisturizer. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down and reading before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on bedside lamp. Pick up book. Sit on bed. Open book. Read. Turn page. Read. Close book. Put book down. Turn off lamp. Lie down. Close eyes. Sleep.
Lying in bed. Eyes closed. Breathing. Turning over. Adjusting pillow. Pulling blanket. Remaining still. Sleeping.
